name: clinic-eye-app
description: Clinic Eye Examination Management Desktop App

scripts.build:win: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.release: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.release:draft: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win --publish onTagOrDraft
